Single axis-aligned rectangle with one rectangular hole does not establish irregular, moving, disconnected, rotated or soft-alpha source topology. A source-presence-gated rectangle-specific implementation could still pass these fixtures.
Presence and conservative support checks do not establish flame pixel appearance or an independent procedural pixel oracle.

Canvas import clears hidden RGB for fully transparent pixels, so retained GPU fixtures do not themselves establish poison immunity or half-alpha linear optics; native numeric controls cover their own CPU reference seam.
Boundary width/flame height scaling and production dimensions/performance remain unmeasured. A logical work admission cap is not a performance result.
Direct oversized-effects rejection and unchanged separate compositor Canvas do not alone prove production Host transaction atomicity or export admission.
